instruction: Open Thunderbird, find the 'Paper Recommendation' email, and save it as forwarded_paper.eml in /home/user/Documents/.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding and saving the Paper Recommendation email from Thunderbird as an .eml file. Evaluator checks if 'forwarded_paper.eml' exists in Documents directory and verifies file content. Custom getter reads the .eml file content, custom metric verifies the file contains 'Paper Recommendation' in subject line to ensure the correct email was saved.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all requirements in the instruction
Getter successfully checks file existence, filename, and reads .eml file content from the correct location (/home/user/Documents/)
Metric correctly verifies: (1) file exists, (2) filename matches 'forwarded_paper.eml', and (3) file content contains 'Paper Recommendation' in the Subject line
The verification logic ensures the correct email was saved with the correct filename in the correct location
Data flow is correct: getter extracts file existence and content → metric verifies filename and subject match
No forwarding verification is needed - instruction only asks to 'save it as forwarded_paper.eml', not to forward the email (the word 'forwarded' is just part of the filename)
validation.fix_applied: Enhanced getter to read .eml file content and metric to verify both file existence and content. Metric now checks for 'Paper Recommendation' in subject line and forwarding indicators (Fwd:, forwarded message, etc.) to ensure email was actually forwarded, addressing both requirements of the task.
